purpose_note: Create a forecast curve for the day. Refine uses the same kitchen sink as blind plus realized price/curve as causal evidence; blind stays immutable.
posterior_rule: R4 catalyst-turn ownership: on a storage day, a realized pre-event extreme and causal turn can own the curve even when the survey surprise is unavailable. Once the turn is followed by same-sign negative price phases, the posterior must model reversal/round-trip rather than impose a generic post-print impulse sign.
lesson: The blind's ABSTAIN was correct, but its curve centered the main impulse after 10:30. Refine shows the important move cresting at 08:37 before the print, then reversing. The missing consensus limited blind directional confidence, but it did not prevent a causal turn model once price was revealed.
carry_forward: On catalyst days, event timing does not automatically own the dominant turn. If a material pre-event extreme is followed by a causal turn and two delivered post-turn phases, let the turn state override the generic print-impulse template.
anti_overfit_note: Endpoint is gap + sum of causal phase price changes (-10+270-190-130=-60), using the same reconstruction rule as every g24 day.
